issue.title: Bug: Auth redirect fails after logout
issue.body:
When logging out and then trying to access a protected route, the redirect to /login sometimes fails and shows a blank screen instead.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Log in as a user
2. Navigate to /profile
3. Log out
4. Try to access /profile again

## Expected
Should redirect to /login immediately

## Actual
Blank screen, console shows auth event not firing
